record.question: Any person empowered to search and seizure, under the NDPS Act, 1985 vexatiously and unnecessarily detains, searches or arrests any person
options: shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two months or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both
shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both
shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both
record.explanation: Vexatious detention, search or arrest attracts up to six months' imprisonment.
